pretreatment: annealing process at 500 uC in air
evidence: Vanadium oxide thin ﬁlms were deposited on titanium plate 0.5 mm thick (99.999% from Goodfellow) at 378 K, with the following pulsing sequence cycle 200/400/2400/1000. To obtain crystallized V 2O5 thin ﬁlms, as-deposited ﬁlms were annealed in air at 773 K for 2 hours.
